note: Eighteen bots a mid-size server actually runs: six generalists, nine specialists and three AI-native entrants. Every row cites one official page and one research claim; pricing is the vendor's list price at retrieval, not a promotional rate. A gap id that is empty means the surveyed capability is already matched and the remaining difference is integration, not a build item.

bots.name: MEE6
bots.freeTier: Basic welcome and starboard, 40 reaction roles; most moderation, automations, levels and custom commands are capped or premium.
bots.paidTier: $11.99/mo, $49.99/yr or $89.99 lifetime, per server; MEE6 AI is a separate subscription.
bots.strongest: Onboarding clarity, level cards and distribution.
bots.weakness: Per-server billing and repeated retroactive re-gating complaints.
bots.gapNote: The rank card is a text/V2 panel, not a generated image; there is no single member timeline.

bots.name: Dyno
bots.freeTier: 19 automod filters, moderation, one reaction-role menu, three giveaways, tickets and starboard; levels and social integrations are paid.
bots.paidTier: Standard $5.99/mo, Premium $7.99/mo and Custom $12.99/mo, per server; annual billing is roughly two months cheaper.
bots.strongest: Automod breadth and a modular dashboard.
bots.weakness: Leveling is paid and some premium features historically required a second bot.
bots.gapNote: No documented case export; the case record is not portable.

bots.name: Carl-bot
bots.freeTier: 250 reaction roles, 5 YouTube and 2 Twitch alerts, 100 weblog entries, automod, basic tags and starboard.
bots.paidTier: $7.99 / $12.99 / $16.99 per month for 1 / 2 / 3 server slots; 1,000 roles, 20/5 feeds, 500 logs, levels, sticky, autopurge, voice-role links, timed roles and Drama Watcher.
bots.strongest: Reaction roles, logging and a human review queue.
bots.weakness: No free leveling; advanced voice-role and persistence-adjacent features are paid.
bots.gapNote: Role persistence and a portable case history are not documented in the free tier.

bots.name: ProBot
bots.freeTier: Welcome images, logs, moderation, autoroles, starboard, reaction roles and invite presentation.
bots.paidTier: $5/mo Tier 1 and $10/mo Tier 2, per server; Tier 2 adds anti-raid and a custom bot identity.
bots.weakness: Thin leveling and shallow depth across the rest.
bots.gapNote: A generated welcome image card is the visible gap; Keystone renders text only.

bots.name: Arcane
bots.freeTier: Message and reaction XP, 15 role rewards, weekly leaderboards and a moderation plugin.
bots.paidTier: $7/mo or $75/yr per server; voice XP, custom XP values, custom rank cards, unlimited role rewards and hourly first-place refresh require Premium and a premium bot invite.
bots.strongest: Leveling depth: curves, reaction XP, voice XP and rank cards.
bots.weakness: Voice XP needs both a subscription and a second bot instance.
bots.gapNote: Voice XP and a generated rank card are the two visible leveling gaps.

bots.name: Lurkr
bots.freeTier: Every feature free forever: 3 role rewards per level and 50 total, 100-user leaderboard, 30 channels, MEE6 import and a public API.
bots.paidTier: $5/mo Ultimate only raises limits: 10 rewards per level and 100 total, 500-user leaderboard, 25 multipliers, 50 channels.
bots.strongest: Free leveling with import, export and a public API.
bots.weakness: Single-purpose; voice XP is not documented.
bots.gapNote: The paywall is honest, but voice XP and a member-wide record are absent.

bots.name: Ticket Tool
bots.freeTier: Unlimited tickets, 3 panels and 5 live flows, transcripts and knowledge base, 30-day history and 10 AI actions.
bots.paidTier: Community $5/mo; Pro $12/mo adds autonomous AI, API and webhook nodes, 12-month retention, SLA and CSAT reports, and a custom KB domain.
bots.strongest: Ticket depth: flow builder, knowledge base, AI assist and a staff dashboard.
bots.weakness: A support silo; autonomous AI and API access sit on the top tier.
bots.gapNote: Knowledge base, canned replies, transcript search and CSAT are the four support gaps.

bots.name: Helper.gg
bots.freeTier: Unlimited tickets, replies from the web panel, staff accounts, ticket logs and AI replies.
bots.paidTier: Premium $4.90/mo adds translation, automation and full customization; Supreme adds $3.90 for a custom bot identity.
bots.strongest: Panel-first support workflow and ticket translation.
bots.weakness: Ticket-only; the AI claim is under-documented.
bots.gapNote: A browser support console, translation and a public knowledge base are the gaps.

bots.name: Wick
bots.freeTier: Core anti-nuke, anti-raid, heat automod, quarantine, lockdown and restore.
bots.paidTier: Premium $5/mo adds advanced anti-raid/anti-nuke, smart backups and panic; VIP $20/mo covers 12 servers with branding and lower latency.
bots.weakness: Security-only; smart backups and advanced quarantine are premium.
bots.gapNote: A structure snapshot and a captcha/alt gate are the missing security pieces.

bots.name: Double Counter
bots.freeTier: Alt detection, raid and VPN/Tor blocking, three verification modes and more than 20 settings.
bots.paidTier: Pro adds ad-free verification, custom embeds and timeouts, fingerprint analytics, cross-database checks and right-click actions; billed inside Discord.
bots.strongest: Cross-server alt and VPN detection with a three-second median verdict.
bots.weakness: A privacy trade-off and a single-purpose bot.
bots.gapNote: Keystone has a join gate but no alt heuristics or captcha provider port.

bots.name: Statbot
bots.freeTier: Message, voice and member statistics, 30-day lookback, four Statroles and eight Statdock counter types.
bots.paidTier: History, Data+, Drilldowns, Statdocks+ and Statroles+ bundles from $8.97 to $14.95/mo; API access requires every upgrade.
bots.strongest: Analytics, Statroles, Statdocks and CSV exports.
bots.weakness: Read-only; no actions, tickets or member record.
bots.gapNote: Statroles and richer counters are the visible gap; Keystone only updates stat channels.

bots.name: Jockie Music
bots.freeTier: Multi-instance playback, queues and 50 collections per person with DJ permissions.
bots.paidTier: Patreon boosts unlock filters at 2 boosts, 24/7 and an extra bot at 5; collections rise to 200.
bots.weakness: Single-purpose, source/legal risk, and 24/7 is paywalled.
bots.gapNote: Keystone has a durable queue and controls but no Lavalink playback.

bots.name: Apollo
bots.freeTier: Unlimited events, one active recurring event, one reminder, signup presets and capacity with an automatic waitlist.
bots.paidTier: Premium $8/mo adds unlimited recurring events, five reminders, restricted events, attendee roles and automatic Google Calendar sync; Pro $25/mo adds cross-posting and custom identity.
bots.strongest: Event scheduling, waitlists, reminders and calendar sync.
bots.weakness: Events-only; the whole product is the feature.
bots.gapNote: Keystone stores events and RSVPs but has no buttons, scheduled reminders or ICS.

bots.name: GiveawayBot
bots.freeTier: Free giveaways with button entry, /greroll and a right-click reroll, /glist and a summary button.
bots.paidTier: Donation-based premium; the feature list is not published.
bots.strongest: A simple, reliable draw and reroll.
bots.weakness: No documented requirements or analytics; single-purpose.
bots.gapNote: Parity: Keystone ships requirements and reroll, so no build gap. The difference is audit and integration.

bots.name: UnbelievaBoat
bots.freeTier: Custom currency, a 25-item shop with two actions and two requirements, games, moderation and 25-message logs.
bots.paidTier: Premium raises the shop to unlimited items with five actions and five requirements, adds ten custom income commands, a custom profile, 30% off role income and 100-message logs.
bots.strongest: Economy depth: shop, income, casino and moderation.
bots.weakness: Single-purpose; most premium value is limits and cosmetics.
bots.gapNote: Keystone has an audited ledger and a shop, but no jobs, custom income or item actions.

bots.name: PeakBot
bots.freeTier: 30+ features including moderation, XP, tickets, welcome, reaction roles and analytics.
bots.paidTier: Starter $4/mo; Pro $8.25/mo or $69/yr adds the AI Server Builder, AI moderation and analytics, and 25 daily backups; per server.
bots.strongest: AI server building and setup speed.
bots.weakness: Vendor marketing; AI features are paid and reliability is unverified.
bots.gapNote: The missing capability is a schema-validated AI setup planner that previews a diff before writing.

bots.name: YourBot
bots.freeTier: Ten services on a shared bot: moderation, tickets, events, analytics, voice, counters and more.
bots.paidTier: Premium $4.99/mo or $47.85/yr per server adds a custom bot, the marketplace, the Plugin Builder and 50 server designs; AI builds are paid from prepaid credits. Beta.
bots.strongest: Service modularity, a sandboxed plugin marketplace and a plugin builder.
bots.weakness: Beta, marketplace trust and AI credit costs.
bots.gapNote: The useful idea is an AI planner with an approval gate, not an unreviewed plugin marketplace.

bots.name: Wallu
bots.freeTier: A 7-day trial; no permanent free tier is documented.
bots.paidTier: Assist plans from $4.99/mo per account with 350 AI responses and 9 channels; ticket automation, voice answers and multi-channel knowledge base.
bots.strongest: Knowledge-grounded support with a strict no-source mode.
bots.weakness: Not a community bot; the AI allowance is per account.
bots.gapNote: A searchable knowledge base with citations and a human handoff is the support gap.
